claims.text: Tetany: calcium gluconate 10 mL of 10% IV over 10 min;
claims.quote: For tetany, calcium gluconate 10 mL of 10% solution IV over 10 minutes is given.

claims.text: repeat boluses or an infusion (20 to 30 mL of 10% in 1 L D5W over 12 to 24 h) may be needed
claims.quote: Repeated boluses or a continuous infusion with 20 to 30 mL of 10% calcium gluconate in 1 L of 5% dextrose in water over the next 12 to 24 hours may be needed.

claims.text: On digoxin: hazardous; give slowly w continuous ECG monitoring after checking (and correcting) K
claims.quote: Infusions of calcium are hazardous in patients receiving digoxin and should be given slowly and with continuous ECG monitoring after checking for (and correcting) hypokalemia.
